## What you are trying to do

The problem, not the solution — it often has a shorter answer than the feature.

## Why the current behaviour does not do it

Check `docs/roadmap.md` §1 and §3 first: several things are deliberately deferred, and
`docs/decisions.md` records why a number of obvious-looking designs were rejected.

## What it would cost

Does it need to spend money, hold a credential, or run on the request path? Those three raise
the bar considerably.
